player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Attic and Home office, repeatedly going east and then west. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I failed to recognize that I had already visited all the rooms and decided to stop the exploration. Next time, I will keep track of the rooms I have visited and take a new, untried direction from the current room if I notice I'm repeating moves. If I'm in a room with only one available direction, I will try to go in that direction and then explore the new room. If I'm in a room with multiple available directions, I will choose a direction that leads to a new room. If I'm in a room with no new rooms to visit, I will check if I have already visited all the rooms and decide to stop the exploration if so.
